base_policy.meaning: Preplaced base displacement is diagnostic only; historical1e-7m is not a scoring veto.

dismantling_ruling.effect: The source mat/assigned target_drop/landing-region rule is superseded. Dismantled baskets may rest at any supported stable position on the table or wooden board. No mat or designated landing coordinate is scored.

distractor_ruling.effect: Only terminal stack identity/order/lid affects distractor scoring. Historical contact and displacement never independently veto a stage.

instruction_authority.hard_discrepancy: score terminal target identities/order/lid; a distractor in the stack is misplaced. No independent movement/use veto. Preserve delivered E2E and historical H5.

measurement_policy: Native poses, quaternions, velocities, signed raw contact manifolds and measured joint states; no expert phase, target, side or action-index annotations.
qualification: No legacy robot/video qualification gates. The original960 held-rest pre-record physics steps are preserved as initialization, never a score gate or episode budget.
stage_mapping_status: Stages score 0/10/20/30/100 using the highest eligible stage without rescaling. The 10-point dismantling stage accepts stable support anywhere on the table or wooden board.
